subtitle: When Katsura causes Saito to be put on trial, it's up to the Yorozuya to save him.

title: Take the Initial Premise Lightly, and It'll Cost You
subtitle: Kagura is in the hospital for a slight cold and tries to milk the situation for sympathy, but everyone thinks she is dying.

title: Keep Your Farewells Short
subtitle: A funeral is held for the still-living Kagura. Can she tell people she's alive before they cremate her?

title: One Editor Is Enough/The G-Pen Is Capricious, and the Maru Pen Is Stubborn
subtitle: Shachi loves a doctor in the prison's dispensary. He shows her his manga that expressing his love for her. / It was decided that Musai Akurogi will make their professional debut. Gintoki gets some dangerous prisoners as their assistants.

title: Strike When the Sword and Overlord Are Hot/Oil Rain
subtitle: Tetsuko asks Yorozuya to watch her sword-smith shop. / Tama gets to know a rickety vending machine named Tabako.

title: Shoguns of Light and Shadow
subtitle: The shogun's assassination is set in motion.

title: Ninja Village
subtitle: The Yorozuya discovers the Ninja Village, the Kihetai start their ambush and Okita confronts Kamui in a battle.

title: Ninja Soul
subtitle: Gintoki and his company arrived in a village of Ninja, and they learn Zenzou's secret plan. It's revealed Shigeshige and Zenzou's past.

title: And Then There Were Five
subtitle: Only Gintoki, Kagura, Shinpachi, Kondo, and Hijikata remain to protect the shogun.

title: Those Who Protect Against All Odds
subtitle: Gintoki takes on Takasugi. Meanwhile Kagura takes on Kamui.

title: Sworn Enemy
subtitle: Gintoki and Takasugi remember when they were boys with Shoyo while they fight a duel.

title: The Crows Caw After the Battle Ends
subtitle: Oboro intervenes in the battle between Gintoki and Takasugi. Meanwhile, it's an unexpected person that is waiting for Shinpachi and his company who escaped from the jaws of death.

title: Farewell, Buddy
subtitle: Shigeshige makes plans for his country's future, and leaves with a promise to see his friends again.

title: The Day the Demon Cried
subtitle: The war is over. Everyone is in the depths of despair. Kondou talks over a cup of sake with Gintoki in Shinsengumi headquarters, and then he appears at Mimawarigumi to be on death penalty.

title: Heroes Always Arrive Fashionably Late
subtitle: Hijikata has been feeling very depressed after Shinsengumi was dissolved. Kozenigata takes him and Gintoki to the bar where Tae works. Unfortunately, Nobunobu comes while they are drinking in the bar.

title: Lost and Found
subtitle: Kondou meets Katsura again in prison. Katsura proposes that Shinsengumi joins hands with his Joi party, and fight together to change this country.

title: Prison Break
subtitle: Shinsengumi under Hijikata and Katsura's Joi party head to Kokujo island where Kondou and Katsura have been captured.

title: Stray Dogs
subtitle: Yorozuya with Tae and Shinsengumi and Katsura's Joi party arrived together at Kokujo island. They start Kondou and Katsura rescue operation.

title: Undelivered Mail
subtitle: All thoughts are entangled in the fierce battle. The Shinsengumi's and the Mimawarigumi's pasts are revealed while Isaburo lets out his true intentions.

title: Karma
subtitle: Isaburo continues his plan of rebellion while the alliance retreats from the island. However, things come to a head, as death itself descends upon the battlefield.

title: Nobume
subtitle: While everyone fights to regroup and escape, Isaburo reaches an epiphany.

title: Farewell Shinsengumi
subtitle: Now wanted fugitives, the Shinsengumi say their goodbyes to their friends in Edo.

title: The Monster and the Monster's Child
subtitle: Katsura hides Yorozuya in the underground town of Akiba, where they meet Imai Nobume. Nobume reveals a shocking truth about the connection between their teacher Shoyo and Utsuro.

title: Leave Letter
subtitle: Kagura leaves for her home planet Rakuyou along with Kihetai without telling Gintoki and Shinpachi and leaves a leave letter at their home. Sakamoto saves Bansai and groups together with Katsura and Gintoki-Shinpachi-Sadaharu, thus forming the Yorozuya-Joui-Kihetai alliance. The group together leaves for Rakuyou planet in order to catch up with Kagura and save their friend Takasugi.

title: The Song of Samurai
subtitle: The alliance arrives at Rakuyou planet and starts their search for Takasugi and Kagura. But they are led into an ambush by Harusame space pirates. Meanwhile the attack also starts on Kagura-Kihetai and Takasugi-Yato groups by the Harusame. This leads to an intense warfare on Rakuyou planet.

title: Zura
subtitle: While the warfare is going on, Katsura tells his comrades, along with Elizabeth to move along while he embraces a fierce fight with Neptune Shoukaku, the leader of 4th division of Harusame and one of the three mad stars.Meanwhile, an unexpected virus enters inside Sakamoto's ship and start's infecting his people. Will both emerge victorious or be defeated?

title: The Two Fools
subtitle: Sakamoto, along with Mutsu and Shogun find out that the virus is a nano virus spread by Uranus Hankai, the leader and only member of 3rd division of Harusame and the second of the three mad stars. The three of them and confront him in an intense battle. Meanwhile, Gintoki faces of with the third mad star, Pluto Batou.

title: 10 Years
subtitle: Gintoki is able to defeat Pluto by instinct and strength. Meanwhile the platoon carrying Takasugi falls under attack. As a result the 3 remaining Joui rebels try to reunite inorder to protect him.

title: Paths
subtitle: As Takasugi finally awakens and the 4 rebels unite together just like old times, the Harusame immediately start a large-scale offensive on the rebels. Meanwhile, Kamui appears and starts fighting with his father Umibozu, which is interrupted by Kagura, his daughter. Also, Gintoki and Shinpachi along with Sadaharu move away from the battlefield in order to find and group with her.

title: The Master of Kouan
subtitle: The past of Kagura's father, Umibozu and his meeting with her mother Kouka is revealed.

title: The Lost Rabbit
subtitle: Kamui, seeing his mother suffer, decides to take her home back to her home planet. His earnest desire grows twisted in time. Meanwhile, the battle between Umibouzu and Utsuro reaches its conclusion, where both are gravely injured and Utsuro leaves the battlefield, with Umibouzu lying on the ground. By that time, Kamui reaches there and tries to fight Umibouzu in front of Kagura and Abuto. Will he kill Umibouzu, his own father?

title: Siblings
subtitle: Kamui tries to put an end to his father's life. Gintoki confronts Kamui, and says Kamui should remember his true title.

title: First Student
subtitle: When Yorozuya prepares to go home, Takechi comes to see Gintoki. He has an message from Takasugi, and says Takasugi has fought with Oboro a while ago. It's revealed Utsuro and Oboro's past in the battle.

title: Hope
subtitle: Yorozuya, Katsura and Sakamoto learn Utsuro and Oboro's past. They leave for home, and Umi-bouzu goes on a journey to find something to defeat Utsuro. All of them make a fresh resolution to fight the final battle.

title: The Stairs to Adulthood May Not Always Lead Up
subtitle: When a boy appears to Kagura with a marriage proposal, her father and Gintoki are outraged.
